# Appeal of Denial for Total Shoulder Replacement (CPT 23472)

**RE: Member: Quinn Carter | Member ID: W589686059 | Reference Number: POC-3B4A598A17-15463 | Denial Date: August 11, 2026 | Payer: Humana (Commercial/ACA), Arizona**

To the Humana Grievances and Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of coverage for total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472), which was denied on August 11, 2026, as not medically necessary. I am asking Humana to reconsider this decision.

## The Governing Policy

The denial notice states that this determination was made "under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria," but it does not name that policy or provide its specific language. I have not been given a policy title, number, or the actual criteria that were applied to my case, so I am not able to quote them here. I want to be clear that nothing in this letter is presented as a quotation from Humana's policy, because I have not seen it.

## Request for the Criteria Used

I am formally requesting that Humana provide, in writing, the specific medical necessity criteria that were applied to deny this request, including the name, number, and version of the policy relied upon. Under my appeal rights, I am entitled to know the exact standard my case was measured against so that I can respond to it directly. Please include this documentation in your response to this appeal.

## My Clinical History

Since I do not have the specific criteria to respond to point by point, I want to lay out the relevant facts from my medical records so that Humana can compare them against whatever standard was used:

- I have had progressive, worsening shoulder pain for 14 months that has not improved with rest.
- I completed 8 weeks of supervised physical therapy (20 visits, from May 20, 2026, to July 15, 2026) focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics. This is documented in my physical therapy discharge note.
- I took NSAIDs for 8 months without adequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on May 5, 2026, which gave only two weeks of partial relief.
- An MRI on June 13, 2026, showed a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- I cannot lift my arm above shoulder height or sleep on the affected side.
- On examination, I had positive provocative testing on the affected side and limited range of motion due to pain.
- I have no active infection and no untreated substance use. My BMI is 29, and I do not smoke.

My surgeon, Dr. Lindqvist, has documented that this surgery is medically needed based on this history, the failed conservative treatment, and the MRI findings. I am asking Humana to weigh this documentation against its own criteria, once those criteria are provided to me.

## Deadline and Where This Appeal Is Being Sent

I understand this appeal must be received by February 7, 2027, which is 180 days from the date of the denial notice. I am submitting this appeal to the address printed on my denial notice, as instructed. I understand that the appeal form is also available at resolutions.humana.com/grievances-appeals-forms, and that expedited appeals can be requested by phone at 1-800-867-6601 or the number on my member ID card.

## What I Am Asking For

I am asking Humana to:

1. Provide the specific written medical necessity criteria used to deny this request.
2. Reconsider this denial in light of the clinical documentation summarized above.
3. Confirm receipt of this appeal and provide a decision within the timeframe required for my plan.

Thank you for your attention to this appeal. Please contact me at the information below if any additional documentation is needed.

Sincerely,

_______________________________
Quinn Carter
Member ID: W589686059
[Address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
Date: [Date of submission]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
